label: a cannon.
why: A model field cannon with two spoked wheels and an upward-angled barrel stands on a white base that turns on a turntable, so the cannon swings from side view to front view and back. The interval starts after the cannon has faded in at 21.5 s and ends before a shell trail is drawn in from 25.5 s; the cut spikes at 17.75 to 19.5 s lie well before it.
